instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-07_input.step. Start from the 110 x 60 x 24 mm rectangular solid and keep that outside bounding box. Add 5 mm chamfers to all top outside edges. Add 4 mm radius fillets to the four vertical outside corners. Cut a shallow rectangular top pocket spanning X=35..75, Y=20..40, and Z=18..24. Do not add holes or split the body; the result must remain one solid. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-07_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
